title: Spicy Ful Medames with Chilli Oil
summary: Canned fava beans simmered with a garlic, cumin and chilli paste, olive oil and tahini, topped with chilli oil.

ingredients.item: Aleppo or mild red chilli flakes
fine sea salt or table salt
400 g can fava beans, with its liquid
olive oil, for the chilli oil
Aleppo or mild red chilli flakes

steps.title: Pound
steps.text: Crush the garlic, cumin, chilli flakes and salt in the mortar to a rough paste.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Put the beans (with the liquid from one can), paste, 60 ml olive oil and tahini in the saucepan and cook over medium-high heat 5 min, stirring, until thick but still saucy.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir in the lemon juice and lightly crush a few beans, leaving most whole.

steps.title: Chilli oil
steps.text: Warm the 2 tbsp oil with the chilli flakes in the small pan 1 min until red; do not let it smoke.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the beans into a bowl, pour over the chilli oil and scatter with parsley.

tips: Toast the cumin seeds in a dry pan for 1 min first.
Aleppo pepper gives colour with mild heat.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
